title: Autoregressive Conditional Neural Processes
mechanism_zh: 把既有独立条件预测器在推理时自回归展开，让前面的预测进入后续上下文，从而形成相关、可非高斯的联合预测。
relation_zh: 联合解释与逐点边缘的区别早已被系统研究。当前模型的联合正常训练不等于推理执行联合异常检验，应把这点写准确。
threat: 基础方法先例
experiment_zh: 控制参数量比较合成高斯与非高斯任务、捕食者种群模拟到真实迁移、脑电时间序列等。
limitation_zh: 顺序和边缘化一致性被放弃，自回归采样耗时；理论优势针对充分数据容量及相应正则条件，不适用于任意实际训练。
verification_note: 本轮分块阅读全文；独立补充材料的取得与阅读范围按 reading_scope 记录。 全文证据：A pretrained conditional neural process can be deployed autoregressively by appending sampled target values to context (Procedure 2.1); its Gaussian conditional marginals generate correlated non-Gaussian joint predictions. Proposition 2.1 gives a KL advantage of the ideal moment-matching AR CNP over the ideal GNP under stated regularity; Proposition 2.2 recovers smooth latent samples with dense inputs and independent finite-variance zero-mean noise. Appendix D shows prediction bias when target density exceeds training support and ordering dependence, recommending random orders. Appendix G–L cover GP/sawtooth/mixture processes, Lotka–Volterra transfer, EEG, beta-plus-endpoint cloud likelihoods and multiscale temperature downscaling. Appendix M auxiliary targets induce multimodality/heavy tails, but gain depends on context size and disappears with 16+ context points. 与当前方法关系：Conditional density prediction is established. Current Student-t mixture directly represents pointwise marginal alternatives with parallel local evaluation, without autoregressive inference or a coherent joint density over complete scans. The ideal-process KL theorem concerns approximation of conditional distributions, not anomaly identification or improved AP/AUROC/FPR95.
